items.title: Player interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2012
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...There has been a number of very famous groups — Nat King Cole. [INTERVIEWEE] That’s true, yeah.

ctx.x: I mean when you think about it, you can have a band without a drummer. You might not want to, but you can. There has been a number of very famous groups — Nat King Cole.
